faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most popular questions about CatGate

items.q1: How is CatGate different from traditional VPN?
items.a1: CatGate uses Zero Trust architecture, providing access only to specific resources rather than the entire network. This enhances security, simplifies management, and eliminates vulnerabilities inherent in traditional VPNs.
items.a2: Basic deployment takes less than 30 minutes. Most customers are up and running within a day. Our support team helps with migration and setup.
items.a3: CatGate supports Windows 10/11, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android. A web client is also available for any modern browser.
items.a4: All connections use end-to-end encryption. We don't store your data, and encryption keys are generated and stored only on your devices. Multi-factor authentication is implemented.
items.a5: No, all plans provide unlimited traffic. We believe security shouldn't be limited by data volume.
items.q6: Can it integrate with existing infrastructure?
items.a6: Yes, CatGate easily integrates with Active Directory, Okta, Google Workspace, Azure AD and other systems. REST API is available for custom integrations.
